summary: Iteration 21 full backend+frontend regression for the four new features (Vault Bulk Actions, Custom Folders, Show Notes, Handoff Expiry Email). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_shows_expiry_email.py — 5/5 pass. POST /api/shows accepts email + returns code; POST /api/admin/run-show-expiry with header X-Admin-Token '1972Hotlive95dj1108**' → 200 {status:'ok', show_reminders:N}; missing/bad token → 401. process_show_expiry() unit test inserts a shared_shows doc (fake email, expires_at now+2d), mocks send_show_expiry_email, and confirms the doc is flipped expiry_reminded:true exactly once (second pass does NOT re-email the same code). Existing tests still pass: test_shows.py 5/5 and test_shows_pin_extend.py 9/9. NOTE: pre-existing licensing tests fail unrelated to this iteration. Frontend Playwright: activated with offline key; Bulk Actions — selecting two takes shows vault-bulk-bar with count '2 selected', bulk-move to Promos populates the Promos filter (both takes appear) and clears the bar; re-select + vault-bulk-delete (confirm auto-accepted) removes both takes. Custom Folders — vault-add-folder → typed 'Weather' → vault-new-folder-save creates chip 'vault-folder-filter-Weather'; the per-take vault-folder-seedC select now lists ['', 'Intros', 'Promos', 'Station IDs', 'Bumpers', 'Weather']; moved seedC → Weather; persisted after full page reload (chip remains, seedC.folder='Weather', localStorage.vaultFolders=['Weather']). Show Notes — cloud-send-note + cloud-send-email fields exist, upload with note/email returns 6-char code (H2M8NS); switching to Receive tab, entering the code, and clicking cloud-receive-button yields cloud-received AND cloud-received-note showing 'Note from sender: Open with the promo'. No blocking console errors (only the pre-existing benign 'span cannot be a child of option' React hydration warning from PlayerBar / TakesVault selects, already flagged in iteration_20).

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (visual-editor dev tooling wraps option children in <span>) — visible in console but non-blocking; carried over from iteration_20.

action_items: (Carry-over from iteration_20) /api/shows/{code}/extend still has no auth/PIN check — anyone knowing a 6-char code can extend it. Rate-limit added (good) but a PIN-protected share should require X-Show-PIN to extend.

(Optional) Consider clearing the auto-set folder filter to 'All' after creating a custom folder if the vault has no takes in that folder — currently creating 'Weather' auto-selects the empty Weather filter, hiding all existing takes until user clicks 'All'. Minor UX polish.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py process_show_expiry() uses to_list(length=1000) — silently caps at 1000 docs. If the shared_shows collection ever grows large, some near-expiry emails will be missed. Consider iterating with an async cursor or increasing the cap.

server.py send_show_expiry_email() logs 'Show expiry email failed' but returns False silently — process_show_expiry then leaves expiry_reminded:false, so the same doc will be retried on every scheduler pass indefinitely. Consider tracking a retry count or last_attempt_at to avoid hammering Resend on a permanently-bad address.

App.js receiveShow returns payload?.note but CloudHandoffModal.doReceive doesn't clear receivedNote when a subsequent receive fails — stale note from a previous successful receive could linger. Minor.
TakesVault submitNewFolder auto-selects the newly-created (empty) folder as the filter, hiding all existing takes; user has to click 'All' to see anything. Minor UX papercut.
Backend admin endpoint POST /api/admin/run-show-expiry has no rate limit — not critical since it's admin-token gated, but a leaked token would allow scheduler abuse.

success_rate.backend: 100% for iteration-21 targets (5/5 new + 14/14 pre-existing shows tests). Licensing suite has pre-existing failures unrelated to this iteration.
